overview.about: The Wyndham Championship is the final event of the PGA Tour's regular season, played at the classic Donald Ross-designed Sedgefield Country Club in Greensboro, North Carolina. It is a last chance for players to climb inside the FedExCup Playoffs cut-off.
overview.nextEvent: The next Wyndham Championship is played at Sedgefield Country Club in Greensboro. Ross's tree-lined layout puts a premium on positioning, and the stakes are high with playoff qualification on the line.
